competition: 2026青年AI音乐嘉年华·单曲组·提报口径：亲情友情（两岸亲情）；备选口径：未来想象（团圆那一天）

target.key_strategy: D major overall, Bm-flavored verses, G-A-D suspended bridge, final chorus modulates up a whole step to E major
target.vocal_range: female lead A3-C5; final chorus peaks B4 with choir support; male fallback down 3-4 semitones

lead_voice.timbre: warm, sincere, folk-rooted youthful female lead, no grit, no scream
lead_voice.narrative_role: first-person grandchild narrating; intro spoken lines in grandma-relayed tone; opera-flavored phrase at Verse 2 line 5 sung by a distant separate voice; outro theme line sung softly

hook.strategy: sentence-level repetition only: hook pair (lines 1,3) verbatim across all choruses; content lines upgraded every pass (副歌二: 望着/乡音/多少年/就等; 结尾副歌: 连着/看得见/老桌前/坐到我身边); no whole-section verbatim repeats (L8)
